✋Palm Reading

Palmistry

Palmistry is a traditional practice that interprets the lines, shapes and features of the hand. A reading offers a guided way to reflect on patterns and personal questions.

Ask about this service

A reading of the hand

The session may discuss major palm lines, mounts and the overall shape of the hand. Interpretations are presented as part of a cultural tradition rather than as scientific or certain predictions.

Bring your questions

Think about the areas of life you would like to discuss. Clear photos of both palms in good lighting can be useful for a remote session; otherwise, ask about appointment options.

Guidance for reflection

Use the conversation to consider your strengths, habits and choices. The reading is intended for personal reflection and does not replace professional support.

How to get started

  1. Arrange an in-person or remote session
  2. Share clear images if requested
  3. Discuss the traditional interpretations
